name: AD — Object Security Descriptor Modified (DACL backdoor)
description: Detects modification of the nTSecurityDescriptor (DACL) on an Active Directory object. Attackers grant themselves rights such as DCSync (Replicating Directory Changes), GenericAll, or WriteDACL to establish stealthy, ACL-based persistence and escalation. Note: AdminSDHolder propagation legitimately rewrites descriptors on protected objects — correlate the subject and target.
note:
## Investigation
1. `SubjectUserName` = who changed the ACL; `ObjectDN` = the object whose rights changed.
2. Rule out AdminSDHolder/SYSTEM propagation. Human-driven descriptor changes on Tier-0 objects (domain root, AdminSDHolder, privileged groups) are the concern.
## Response
Inspect the granted ACE; if a backdoor right was added, remove it and investigate the subject.
author: raadabujaish
